purpose: Assess unchanged historical frequency targets on the development cohort after the next mechanics freeze; this is not the predeclared independent cohort.
original_gate_rule: Retain and report every original12-seed failure. Do not substitute a favorable subset or alter an outcome definition.

bernoulli_sizing.formula: ceil(z^2 * p * (1-p) / min(p-lower,upper-p)^2), rounded up to the next20 seeds; never below current cohort size
bernoulli_sizing.condition: Only when estimated p lies strictly within the existing target interval. Otherwise the mechanic remains outside target; larger n is not a repair. Report estimates and uncertainty honestly; the plug-in formula is a sizing approximation, not a guaranteed confidence bound.

a1_targets: Unchanged median4..14 successful coups against elected governments, median top3 share below0.5. No frequency quota widening or same-coup reclassification.
validation: A revised sample size, if justified by the existing test specification, must be documented and executed; then the untouched independent cohort validates the frozen mechanics. Never inspect independent data to select sample size or parameters.
